description: This file defines a report parser class for generating third-party ledger reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for date range calculations, context setting, and data aggregation for partner accounts.

classes.name: third_party_ledger
classes.description: A report parser class for generating third-party ledger reports, with methods for date calculations, context setup, and data aggregation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context variables.

methods.name: date_range
methods.description: Generates a list of date strings between start and end dates.

methods.name: transform_period_into_date_array
methods.description: Converts selected periods into a list of date strings.

methods.name: transform_date_into_date_array
methods.description: Converts specific start and end dates into a list of date strings.

methods.name: transform_both_into_date_array
methods.description: Combines period and date filters into a final date list.

methods.name: transform_none_into_date_array
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum and maximum dates from account move lines and creates a date list.

methods.name: comma_me
methods.description: Formats a number with thousand separators.

methods.name: special_map
methods.description: Creates a comma-separated string of date list entries.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets the report context, including date ranges, account types, and partner filtering.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Retrieves move lines for a partner within the date range, including balances.

methods.name: _sum_debit_partner
methods.description: Calculates total debit for a partner within the date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit_partner
methods.description: Calculates total credit for a partner within the date range.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit for selected partners within the date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit for selected partners within the date range.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Retrieves the company name for the report.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency name for the company.
